scope: Bound pending-parent and child-first orphan unordered-map bucket growth before reserve/insert under the shared POLYLINE staging budget, including a conservative replacement bucket-array peak estimate.

method.kind: Focused generated in-memory safety control and strict owning-target validation

implementation.ledger: Before owner-map reserve/insert, check both the retained bucket-count delta upper bound and a conservative full replacement bucket-pointer-array estimate against the remaining 256 MiB staging budget. Existing retained bytes and the incoming owner-node estimate remain charged during this preflight.
implementation.postcondition: After reserve, measure the actual bucket-count delta and reject/rollback if it exceeds the declared bound or accounting policy.
limitations: The model estimates pointer-array bytes and does not bound baseline bucket arrays.
Allocator metadata, allocator retention, and implementation-specific transient allocations are outside the ledger; this is not an RSS guarantee.
The selector uses generated maps and synthetic frame state; source-location/callback and full actual-reader pipeline coverage remain open.

tests: one-byte-under transient replacement-array allowance refusal without map growth
successful admission when retained and transient bounds fit
actual retained bucket charge remains within the modeled delta
estimated replacement array covers the resulting bucket pointer count

workspace.reason: The shared worktree contains broad unrelated dirty changes; this focused slice remains uncommitted to avoid capturing unrelated user work.
